name: Profile Completion
tagline: A meter that reports how much of a defined, optional set of profile attributes the user has supplied, and names what's still outstanding as something to add.
desc: Profile completion maintains a defined, optional set of attributes the user may supply about themselves and reports how full that set is as a proportion, a percentage, a bar, a fraction, or a run of markers, while naming at least one outstanding member as an action the user can take. Supplying a member changes only the reported proportion and what other people can see; nothing else the product tracks changes because of it. The line that matters most is what happens, if anything, as the figure moves: this entry covers the proportion reported continuously, with no response of its own to any point along the way. The moment a crossing partway through is called out separately, that crossing is a Milestone; the moment the completed set is kept as a badge, status, or record that outlives the meter, that's an Achievement. Both can sit on the same surface as this entry, each classified on its own terms.
principle: An incomplete meter reads as unfinished business. Naming exactly what's missing turns a vague sense of not-done into one specific, low-effort action to take next.
warn: The boundary against Milestone and Achievement is this entry's weakest edge: a figure that recognizes nothing between empty and full is this entry, and the moment crossing any point, including the full proportion, produces a response of its own, that response is Milestone or Achievement layered on top, not a reason to drop this label. The same care applies against Set Collection, where members are obtained rather than stated, and against a mandatory setup flow, which is onboarding rather than an optional set the product functions without.
variants: Single-item prompt, one outstanding member is named at a time and the rest are not listed
Itemised checklist, every outstanding member is listed at once and can be taken in any order
Explained item, each outstanding member carries a stated reason the product gives for supplying it
Prompted completion, the product raises an outstanding member unprompted, at a moment of its own choosing
Dismissible indicator, the statement can be cleared by the user without the set being completed
lifecycle: Needs a defined, optional set of self-supplied attributes before there's a proportion to report at all, so it has nothing to show a brand-new account with no such set yet. Most visible in the stretch between a fresh account and a full one, and stops being shown once the set is complete.
